title: Follow successive generations through one continuous reading space

motion.summary: Successive father-and-child statements occupy positions along a shared horizontal structure; the view changes its framing to bring later generations into reading position.
phases: Introduce the first relationship against a spatial rail.
Complete the first clause before moving attention onward.
Continue along the same coordinate system through successive names.
motion.transferablePrinciple: Give a chain of relationships a shared geography so progression feels like one journey instead of unrelated title cards.
variations: Follow connected rooms, branches, stones or solid architectural spans instead of a thin rail.
Use the same principle for a causal sequence, pilgrimage or historical timeline.
Allow a later camera pullback to reveal how the visited relationships connect.
cautions: Do not move the camera faster than a person can finish the current clause.
Keep ancestry claims grounded in the source text.
Give a new project a fresh spatial metaphor rather than copying the rail arrangement.

quality.reviewer: agent visual inspection of decoded frame sequence
strengths: Repeated relationship language is supported by a single coherent reading direction.
The early red names establish hierarchy without coloring every later word.
limitations: One sampled frame shows departing text clipped at the left edge; exit cropping must happen after the phrase is readable.
The lower placement leaves considerable empty space and may need rebalancing on portrait screens.
Observed from six decoded frames of the exact hashed MP4; this is a concept reference, not full motion, audio-sync or whole-film acceptance.
